material_comparison_contract.cut_plan_rule: Placas, painéis, carpete e perfis podem exigir otimização de cortes; área/volume teórico é limite inferior, não plano de compra.
material_comparison_contract.normalized_price_rule: Tax-inclusive source amounts must be decomposed using evidence; unknown tax, freight or price prevents a confirmed final total. Landed material cost already contains its line taxes.

labor_rate_contract.oews_use: Benchmark de salário de empregado por ocupação/geografia/data; não tarifa faturável.
labor_rate_contract.cost_model: Somar componentes compatíveis na mesma base horária; não acrescentar benefício já incluído em taxa carregada.
labor_rate_contract.subcontract_quote_mode: Se subcontrato inclui material/mão de obra/equipamento, registrar cobertura da cotação e suprimir as linhas sobrepostas.

formulas.expression: if confirmed_measure == 0: packages = 0; else: demand = measure * (1 + waste_fraction); raw_packages = demand / net_coverage_per_package; packages = ceil(max(minimum_order_packages, raw_packages) / order_increment_packages) * order_increment_packages
requirements: measure >= 0
waste_fraction >= 0 explicitly confirmed; zero allowed only with evidence/selection
net_coverage_per_package > 0 in the same measure_unit
minimum and increment explicitly confirmed
layer count appears either in measure or in coverage for total system, never both
overlap belongs in net coverage or geometric demand, never again in waste
minimum charge/order applies only when active and demand > 0; confirmed zero scope costs zero
formulas.null_policy: Any required unknown => pending; no conversion null to zero or one.

formulas.expression: productive_crew_hours = quantity / productivity; crew_hours = productive_crew_hours * site_condition_multiplier + setup_crew_hours + cleanup_crew_hours; labor_cost = sum(role_headcount * role_participation_crew_hours * role_loaded_cost_per_worker_hour)
requirements: productivity > 0 refers to the confirmed complete crew composition
role_participation_crew_hours <= crew_hours unless separately explained
Do not multiply crew productivity by crew size a second time
Nonproductive waiting and re-visits entered separately; elapsed calendar days are not worker-hours
Direct worker-hour-per-unit rates use a separate mode, not this crew formula
formulas.null_policy: Unknown productivity or role rate blocks numeric labor total.

formulas.expression: equipment_cost = normalized_tax_exclusive_period_cost + tax_exclusive_extra_meter_hours_cost + tax_exclusive_delivery + tax_exclusive_pickup + tax_exclusive_mobilization + tax_exclusive_assembly_dismantling + operator_if_not_in_labor + tax_exclusive_fuel_or_energy + tax_exclusive_confirmed_fees + unique_allocated_nonrecoverable_line_taxes
requirements: Use supplier billing periods and shift/meter limits, not guessed calendar-month length
Rental duration includes applicable waiting/off-rent terms
Do not apply rental rates and owned-equipment hourly cost simultaneously
Shared resource allocation weights sum to one
Explicit exclusion is required to omit a charge; unknown is not zero
All quoted equipment amounts are normalized according to tax_cost_contract; embedded taxes must not be added to gross source amounts again.
Every allocated line tax has a unique tax_charge_id; equipment_cost already includes it and construction_margin must not repeat it.
Rental quote reference must resolve under supplier_quote_contract, with price, delivery/pickup, tax and required fees resolved.
formulas.null_policy: Missing quote, freshness/location evidence, price, freight, tax or required terms => pending equipment total; known partial subtotal may be shown with missing items.

formulas.expression: cost_base = direct_cost + allocated_overhead + explicit_contingency + unallocated_nonrecoverable_taxes; pre_output_tax_price = cost_base / (1 - target_margin)
requirements: 0 <= target_margin < 1
Profit is not overhead, contingency or collected output tax
Tax rules/bases require jurisdiction input
If selling-price fees apply, use fee-aware equation instead
Direct landed costs already contain their nonrecoverable line taxes according to tax_cost_contract.
unallocated_nonrecoverable_taxes contains only unique charges not included in direct_cost, overhead, contingency or other allocations.
Deduplicate economic source tax charges by tax_charge_id and source_charge_reference; split allocations must sum to the charge once.
No confirmed final price if required supplier quote freshness, price, freight, tax or availability is pending.
formulas.null_policy: Missing policy, tax identity/allocation, valid quote or cost => pending; known subtotal remains labeled partial.

formulas.expression: price = cost_base * (1 + markup); margin = markup / (1 + markup); markup = margin / (1 - margin)
requirements: Choose markup OR margin; never apply both to the same cost base
State whether cost base includes overhead

formulas.expression: provider_cost = sum(measured_or_quoted_units_by_meter * effective_price_per_meter_unit); conservative_job_cost = provider_first_attempt_cost + explicit_retry_reserve + fallback_reserve + OCR_storage_egress_export_cost + support_allocation
requirements: Version provider/model/meter/currency/pricing-date
No cross-provider balance pooling
Retry/fallback reserves cannot authorize calls
Reserve worst permitted attempt chain for authorization; expected-cost forecast is a separate field
Deduplicate job/attempt/event charges by idempotency key
formulas.null_policy: Unknown provider tariff or units => quote_pending, never free.

requirements: target_profit_table_ref must exist and target_type must be explicit
denominator > 0
If payment fee base includes tax/cross-border/conversion add the actual fee model instead of reusing this simplified equation
Cost base covers relevant provider, reserve, support and allocated platform costs
Monthly and per-project calculations have separate cost allocation periods
formulas.null_policy: No existing target table, provider rates or fee inputs => pricing_pending.

requirements: Use only when original target table expresses absolute profit, not margin
denominator > 0
Monthly absolute target must be allocated by explicit account/adoption policy; no invented user count
formulas.null_policy: Missing original target or allocation => pricing_pending.

implementation_validation.revision_note: 1.1.0 adds explicit line-tax convention and supplier quotation/freshness entities; existing service, component, equipment IDs and measurement ASTs are unchanged.

tax_cost_contract.normalization: Normalize supplier prices and non-tax charges to tax-exclusive amounts using source evidence. A tax already embedded in a quoted gross amount is decomposed before recomposition, never added again to that gross amount.
tax_cost_contract.unallocated_definition: Only identified nonrecoverable cost tax charges not embedded in any direct, overhead or contingency line, and not already allocated elsewhere in this estimate.
rules: tax_charge_id identifies an economic source charge once per estimate; UUID duplication must not duplicate the same source_charge_reference.
Every tax amount entering a cost has tax_charge_id provenance. Unknown source identity, amount, tax inclusion or recoverability blocks a confirmed final total.
Splitting one charge across lines is permitted only with allocation sum equal to the charge amount; it is not a new tax charge per line.
A charge cannot be both allocated/embedded in a cost line and in unallocated_nonrecoverable_taxes.
Nonrecoverable line taxes are already inside material/equipment/subcontract/direct cost totals; never sum them again at construction_margin.
A quoted tax-inclusive amount must be decomposed from reliable evidence before tax-exclusive formulas run. Do not guess the tax rate or amount.
An empty ledger does not prove tax is zero. Explicit evidence is required for not_applicable, included or excluded treatment.
Output taxes and recoverable taxes remain separate under confirmed jurisdiction/accounting rules; this catalog sets no local tax rate.

supplier_quote_contract.entity_definition: One immutable quote record for one identifiable material SKU or equipment configuration and commercial location/delivery context. A supplier document may create several records sharing document reference.
supplier_quote_contract.legacy_snapshot_fields: Material price_observed_at/unit_price_per_package and equipment observed_at/rates are derived snapshots only. They must agree with the immutable referenced quote and cannot independently establish freshness.

freshness_rules.when: Required project/delivery ZIP, branch or project timezone is missing; do not substitute a national price.
Source requires partner access not available/authorized; record limitation without asserting access or availability.
No usable quote, item/spec/unit/currency mismatch, missing price-as-of evidence, missing validity policy, or unresolved price/freight/tax/required fees.
Latest source retrieval/revalidation failed; preserve previous record and its original timestamps, but do not mark it current because retrieval was attempted.
